body.title: Deduplicate fallback events for newly discovered directories
body.reproduction: watcher-new-directories injects a rejecting per-directory subscription after a real repository subscription. The existing file must still be reported exactly once, but the audit observes four reports and fails 4 !== 1.
body.rootCause: Multiple discovery/event paths in the subscription-failure scenario produce duplicate notifications for the same file. The exact filesystem-event interleaving was not isolated by the audit, so the batch must first establish a deterministic reproduction.
body.fixIntent: Ensure fallback discovery and ordinary watcher events provide the intended per-change notification semantics after subscription failure without losing files, suppressing real later changes or producing unhandled rejections. Acceptance: nested/new-directory failure cases report each initial file once, independent later modifications are delivered, and existing ignore/filter behavior remains intact. Keep retired review freshness behavior out of scope.
